title: Watercolor "Serenity Path" 695 Western Lake Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 12 wristbands.- 4 adult bikes- Separate Carriage House- Spacious porches - Living area on each floor- Outdoor shower- This property comes with 3 dedicated parking spots. Additional parking can be found throughout the community. - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout.Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: This Park District home is perfect for a family looking for spacious accommodations for up to sixteen people. You will recognize it's charm as soon as you enter this home. Right off of the foyer you will find a spectacular library filled with amazing books to enjoy during your stay and beautifully lit by a a sky light. The first floor of this home has two bedrooms - one guest bedroom with full-over-full bunks and an ensuite with shower/tub combo, and the luxurious primary is located just down the hallway. The primary retreat is furnished with a king bed, an ensuite bath and a private screened porch with trail views!Upstairs you will enter the grand shared space, which includes a gourmet kitchen, a built-in dining nook, a screened porch and an ultra-inviting living room. Also on this floor you will find a room featuring two twin beds. This room has convenient access to the hall bathroom with shower/tub combo.The final bedroom is found in the private carriage house. This can either be accessed from the second floor kitchen or just off the entrance to the main home! This carriage house was built with a unique design and sleeps 6 guests comfortably! With a king built-in on the first floor and a twin-over-twin built-in bunk just above, this home is ideal for extra guests or kids! The carriage house also features an open porch, private bathroom, breakfast nook and kitchenette.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: Two Full over Full Bunk Beds (8), Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Primary Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Shower and TubSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds (2), Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyCARRIAGE HOUSE:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed and Twin over Twin Bunk Bed (4), Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo WATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS:- Named the #1 Family Vacation Destination in the U.S.- A 499 acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for Family Getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 4 swimming pools- Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens and foot paths- Nearby state parks and preservesWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community and 360 Blue fines.Please note: Effective March 15, 2014, Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.

With a king built-in on the first floor and a twin-over-twin built-in bunk just above, this home is ideal for extra guests or kids! The carriage house also features an open porch, private bathroom, breakfast nook and kitchenette.
